message.reasoning:
The user wants a single self-contained HTML file with an animated scene of someone cycling along a seaside road, needing visible pedal/wheel animation loops and ocean/sky/road elements, with no external dependencies.

I'm planning a canvas animation with layered parallax scrolling: sky gradient with sun and clouds, distant islands, a sea with moving wave lines and sun reflection, a sandy beach with foam, a road with dashed lines, palm trees, seagulls, and a cyclist whose wheels, pedals, and legs animate through rotation math tied to scroll speed.

Working out bike geometry...

Mapping the frame tubes, fork, and handlebar positions, then figuring the rider's hip, shoulder, head, and arm placement so the pose connects naturally to the pedal and handlebar points.

Clamping leg length so the pedal distance stays within reach, and planning the draw order: far leg and pedal first, then the bike frame and wheels, then near crank, near leg, torso, and arm on top. Working out wheel details with spokes, a chainring and chain line, overall bike scale relative to canvas size, plus sine-wave shoreline foam and simple flapping seagull shapes.

Adding scarf flutter and a ground shadow under the bike, computing wheel rotation from travel distance and speed, and sketching a curved palm tree trunk with leaf curves. Laying out the scene bands for road, beach, and sea, positioning the rider's wheel centers relative to the road, and setting up parallax tiling math for repeated background objects.

Setting up the canvas resize and hashing function...

Now I'm sketching out the scene elements: clouds as soft white ellipses, a sun reflection shimmering across the sea, wave rows animated with sine motion, and functions for drawing a leaning palm tree with swaying leaves, plus a cyclist rig with trunk, legs, and limb articulation.

I'm working through inverse kinematics for the legs and arms so joints bend naturally toward the foot and hand positions, keeping knee and elbow angles oriented correctly in canvas space, then setting up pedal crank dimensions.

I'm planning the full scene assembly: feet positioned on pedals with offset crank angles, a bobbing hip motion synced to pedaling, a trailing wavy scarf, and rendering everything within a translated/scaled local coordinate system with a render loop. I also want asphalt road details -- gradient surface, white edge lines, and a moving dashed yellow center line -- plus an optional small Chinese caption, all delivered as a single self-contained HTML code block.

Now I'm adding a seawall or railing between the beach and road, sandy foreground with grass tufts further down, and a distant island with a lighthouse rendered in simple stripes since it's daytime. Time to write the code.
